title: data-cap Policy Model
description: Canonical, versioned declared data-flow rules and their evaluation results against the Flow Model (see ADR 0070). Generated from src/flow/policy-model.ts's PolicyModel type -- never hand-authored.

rules.description: The declared rules, ordered by id.

results.description: Every evaluation result, ordered by rule, subject, boundary.

forbidDestinations.description: Boundary kinds the governed fields must never reach.

allowedDestinations.description: If set, the only boundary kinds the governed fields may reach.

allowedHandling.description: Handling that exempts a crossing from `forbidDestinations`/`allowedDestinations`.

requireHandling.description: If set, every boundary crossing of a governed field must declare one of these handlings.

FlowPolicyRule.description: One declared data-flow rule. At least one constraint must be set.

classification.description: Exact match against a field node's `classification`.

field.description: Exact match against a field node's `name` (for example `User.email`).

scope.description: Restricts the rule to fields declared in this file (a root-relative path); never sufficient on its own.

path.description: Narrows the rule to one path inside each matching field (for example `["passwordHash"]`): only flow of that path, or of the whole field, counts.

FlowPolicyAppliesTo.description: Which fields a rule applies to; every supplied criterion must match, and at least one is required.

FlowBoundaryKind.description: What a data-flow rule can name as a destination: the declared endpoint kinds, plus the two destinations only code analysis can see.

DataFlowEndpointKind.description: What kind of boundary a declared data-flow endpoint crosses -- a data store (`database`/`cache`/`storage`/`queue`), an external entity (`api`/`external-service`/`user-input`), or something internal to this codebase (`computed`/`internal`).

FlowHandling.description: The declared data-safety state of a value at a boundary crossing -- the vocabulary of `DataFlowEndpoint.handling` and of flow policy rules.

subject.description: Id of the field node the rule was evaluated for; absent only for `rule-matches-nothing`.

boundary.description: Id of the boundary node this result concerns; absent when none was reached or the result is about the trace as a whole.

basis.description: The weakest epistemic status of the edges the result rests on (`unknown` for an indeterminate result).

edges.description: Ids of the edges on the path that justifies this result.

PolicyOutcome.description: How a rule fared against one field (and, when relevant, one boundary).

FlowStatus.description: ADR 0071: the five epistemic statuses, shared by every flow fact, claim and finding.
